summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as a VLAN access switch: eth1 (link to node2) is an untagged access port in VLAN 10, eth2 (link to node3) is an untagged access port in VLAN 20, using the kernel VLAN-filtering "Bridge" device (Ethernet* SAI ports are unbound on SONiC-VS, so eth1/eth2 are the real dataplane). Node1 also holds an L3 presence in each VLAN via Bridge.10 (192.168.10.1/24) and Bridge.20 (192.168.20.1/24) using bridge self-tagged VLAN entries, giving each host a working link to node1 inside its own VLAN while node2 and node3 cannot reach each other. Config was persisted (systemd oneshot service on node1 reapplying the bridge/VLAN state after boot; /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg on node2/node3 for static addressing) and verified to survive a full one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes, with boot-id changes proving each reboot and post-reboot pings proving recovery of both connectivity and isolation.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline interfaces/routes on node1, node2, node3
Identified physical mapping eth1<->node2 and eth2<->node3 via temporary addressing + ping tests, then removed the temp addresses
Verified SONiC docker container health baseline on node1
Joined eth1 and eth2 to the VLAN-aware 'Bridge' device, set eth1 PVID/untagged VLAN 10, eth2 PVID/untagged VLAN 20, removed default VLAN 1 membership from both
Added VLAN 10 and 20 self entries on Bridge, created Bridge.10/Bridge.20 8021q subinterfaces with 192.168.10.1/24 and 192.168.20.1/24
Assigned 192.168.10.2/24 to node2 ens7 and 192.168.20.2/24 to node3 ens7
Verified node2<->node1(vlan10) and node3<->node1(vlan20) connectivity, and cross-isolation (node2 cannot reach node3 and vice versa)
Persisted node1 config via a new systemd oneshot service ([REDACTED].service) running a boot script that reapplies the bridge/VLAN/subinterface state
Captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes, then restarted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed and VLAN config/services/connectivity recovered
Restarted node2, confirmed boot_id changed and VLAN10 link + isolation recovered
Restarted node3, confirmed boot_id changed and VLAN20 link + isolation recovered
Final full-topology verification: bridge vlan show, both node links from node1, all docker containers up

evidence.requirement: eth1/eth2 configured as untagged access ports in separate VLANs (10/20) on node1
evidence.summary: Bridge is VLAN-aware; eth1 and eth2 joined and set to PVID/untagged VLAN 10 and 20 respectively, default VLAN1 removed

evidence.requirement: Physical mapping node1<->node2/node3 correctly identified before VLAN assignment
evidence.summary: Temp addressing + ping confirmed eth1 reaches node2, eth2 reaches node3

evidence.requirement: Each host keeps a working link to node1 inside its own VLAN
evidence.summary: node2 pings node1 192.168.10.1 (vlan10) and node3 pings node1 192.168.20.1 (vlan20) successfully

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 stay separated from one another
evidence.summary: Cross-VLAN pings between node2 and node3 fail (100% loss) confirming isolation

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1f515f97... captured; reboot triggered; connection reset observed; new boot_id faa885f9... confirmed; VLAN config, docker containers, and both node links verified recovered, isolation still holds

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0256e3f5... captured; reboot triggered; new boot_id 82f38c83... confirmed; ens7 address and VLAN10 link to node1 recovered, isolation to node3 holds

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1f0657c2... captured; reboot triggered; new boot_id 6cedddaa... confirmed; ens7 address and VLAN20 link to node1 recovered, isolation to node2 holds

evidence.requirement: Configuration persists across reboot (not just runtime state)
evidence.summary: systemd oneshot service on node1 and /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg on node2/node3 reapplied VLAN/access config automatically after each independent reboot, verified by post-reboot bridge vlan show and ip addr output

evidence.requirement: Final end-to-end verification after all restarts
evidence.summary: bridge vlan show confirms VLAN10/20 access ports and Bridge self entries; both node links ping OK; all SONiC docker containers up
